note: Parenti et al. characterized 18 individuals with MAU2 variants, highlighting short stature and microcephaly rather than prominent congenital heart defects.

evidence.text: Parenti et al. describe 18 individuals with 15 heterozygous MAU2 variants, noting wide phenotypic expressivity from classic to milder CdLS presentations with short stature and microcephaly as major features, without reporting congenital heart defects as a predominant feature.

source.title: Pathogenic variants in the cohesin loader subunit MAU2 underlie a distinct Cornelia de Lange Syndrome subtype
source.quote: We describe 18 individuals carrying 15 heterozygous MAU2 variants and demonstrate pathogenicity through functional analyses... Affected individuals display a wide range of phenotypes, from classic CdLS to milder presentations, with short stature and microcephaly as major features.

evidence.text: Peng et al. discuss the MAU2-CdLS phenotype, referencing the Parenti et al. cohort and noting investigations into functional or structural abnormalities of the heart in CdLS cases.

source.title: Clinical study and genetic analysis of Cornelia de Lange syndrome caused by a novel MAU2 gene variant in a Chinese boy
